mapper.update: update attractions set parent_poi_id = #{parentPoiId}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, location = #{location}, pcode = #{pcode}, pname = #{pname}, citycode = #{citycode}, cityname = #{cityname}, adcode = #{adcode}, adname = #{adname}, type = #{type}, typecode = #{typecode}, distance = #{distance}, opentime_today = #{opentimeToday}, opentime_week = #{opentimeWeek}, tel = #{tel}, status = coalesce(#{status}, status) where poi_id = #{poiId}
